claim_one_line: THE RIGID CENSUS'S SMOOTHNESS IN TAU (Step B's revision, P-521; aggregates only; data-free): on B1726's grid the frame's outputs are smooth in Im tau almost everywhere -- median second difference 0.0008 decades, 99% below 0.041, 0.54% above 0.08 -- so a quadratic interpolant meets the resolution check on about 99.5% of cells, and the rest (the order-4 lines, q99 1.7034; the curved cells; 7568 degeneracy crossings) needs local refinement, not a 5x grid. The census read once, through a committed script that checks it against its recorded manifest. None of the 19. [Sharpened 2026-10-30 by B1820: per series along Im tau; along Re tau 7.75% exceed and, per configuration, nearly every interval needs refining -- the refinement is near-uniform, about 86 CPU-hours, not targeted.]
